movie:157336.text: I'm a robot on a space mission. My honesty setting is at ninety percent, and you can turn my humour down.
I run a secret space program in a world that's running out of food. Do not go gentle into that good night.
We landed on a water planet near a black hole, where every hour costs seven years back home.
My father left on a space mission when I was a girl. Books kept falling off my bedroom shelf.
I was a farmer in a world choking on dust, until they asked me to fly through a wormhole to find humanity a new home.

movie:27205.text: I mix the sedatives that let a whole team fall asleep on a plane, and then fall asleep inside the sleep, and inside that.
I paid a crew to change my rival's son's mind. My fee was one phone call that let a wanted man go home to his children.
A professor asked me to design mazes for a client. The first time I folded a whole city over my own head, I was hooked.
On a long flight, I dreamed my dying father finally told me he wanted me to be my own man, not a copy of him.
I steal secrets from inside people's dreams. I keep a little spinning top in my pocket to check whether I'm still dreaming.

movie:24428.who: The old man in the crowd
movie:24428.text: A man in a horned helmet ordered a crowd in Germany to kneel before him. I refused.
I asked a war hero from the forties to sign my vintage trading cards. I never got the chance.
A god with a glowing staff took over my mind. I shot for the wrong side until a friend knocked some sense into me.
That's my secret, I told them: I'm always angry.
I brought together a team of heroes, a soldier, a god and a genius in a suit, to stop an invasion from space.

movie:155.text: I took a shotgun to the men robbing my bank. The last one standing wore a clown mask and left a grenade in my mouth.
I worked out which billionaire was paying for a masked vigilante and planned to say his name on live TV. Suddenly the whole city wanted me dead.
I faked my own death to catch a madman, and still ended up with a gun pointed at my wife and kids.
They called me the city's great hope. Then I lost the woman I loved and half my face, and started letting a coin decide who lives.
Some men just want to watch the world burn, I told him. He wears the mask; I patch him up afterwards.

movie:550.text: I promised to shut down a gang of vandals. Then men from my own department cornered me in a bathroom with a rubber band and a knife.

movie:550.who: The big man from the support group
movie:550.text: I lost a lot to cancer. A skinny guy kept coming to my support group to cry in my arms, and then he stopped coming.
I went to support groups for diseases I didn't have. It's cheaper than a movie, and there's free coffee.
My employee came in bruised, beat himself up in my office, and blackmailed me into paying him to stay home.
I sell soap. I met a sleepless man on a plane, his apartment blew up, and we started something in a bar basement. The first rule: you don't talk about it.

movie:293660.text: I drive a mercenary in a red suit around the city. He gives me love advice, the worst kind.
I'm a blind old woman, and I build flat-pack furniture without looking. My roommate is a very scarred man.
I ran the experiment that scarred him, and I can't feel pain. He keeps making fun of my real first name.
We met in a strip club and celebrated every holiday together. Then he got cancer and disappeared.
I signed up for a cure for my cancer and came out with a face like a bad avocado and the power to heal from anything.

movie:299536.text: I forged weapons for the gods. I made a terrible glove for a titan, and he took my hands.
I was raised by the warlord who killed half my people. I know where one of his precious stones is hidden.
I looked at fourteen million futures. We win in only one.
A band of misfits pulled me out of space, and I went to forge a new weapon in the heart of a dying star.
I'm collecting six stones for my glove. With a snap of my fingers, half of all life will be gone.

movie:278.text: I spent fifty years inside. When they finally let me out, the world had changed so much I couldn't bear it.
I told a fellow inmate I knew who really committed the murders he was in for. That same night, the warden had me shot.
An inmate who used to be a banker kept my books and hid my money. One morning his cell was empty, behind a poster of a pin-up girl.
I'd beaten men half to death. A new inmate offered to sort out my taxes, and the work crew got cold beers on the roof.

movie:278.who: The man who can get things
movie:278.text: I can get you anything inside: a rock hammer, a poster. My friend asked for both, and twenty years later he crawled through a sewer to freedom.

movie:680.text: We were just two lovers robbing a coffee shop. A man in a corner booth with a very rude wallet talked us out of it.
People call me when there's a mess. This morning it was a car full of brains and two hit men in borrowed T-shirts.
Two men burst into my house in the middle of the night with a woman who'd overdosed. I had to stab her in the heart with a needle.
I was paid to lose a fight and I didn't. I went back for my father's gold watch, and ended up in a very bad pawn shop basement.
My husband's hit man took me to a fifties-themed restaurant, and we won a twist contest.

movie:13.text: He told me he'd been shot in the backside in Vietnam, then dropped his trousers in my office to show me.
I knew everything about shrimp. I never made it home from the war, but he started the shrimp business anyway, just like we planned.
He carried me out of the jungle when I wanted to die with my men. I lost my legs, and years later we got rich on his boat.
He ran into my life when we were kids and never stopped. I kept running away. In the end, I married him.
Life is like a box of chocolates, I told my boy. He needed leg braces to walk, and then one day he ran.

movie:118340.text: I keep rare creatures in glass cases. A band of outlaws brought me an orb, and my assistant touched it.
I snatched a boy from Earth and raised him as a space pirate instead of handing him over.
I only say three words. I grew a shield of branches around my friends.
I am not a raccoon. I build guns, collect bounties and plan prison breaks.
I was taken from Earth as a kid, and all I have left is a mixtape from my mum. Then I stole an orb everyone wanted.

movie:671.text: I'd never seen Brazil. One day the glass of my tank vanished, and a boy who could talk to me let me go.
My cousin lived under our stairs. On his birthday a giant broke down the door and gave me a pig's tail.
I broke down a door on a stormy island to tell a boy who he really was. Later I won a dragon's egg in a card game.
I correct everyone's spells. On the train on the first day, I told a boy he had dirt on his nose.
I've lived under the stairs my whole life. Then, before my eleventh birthday, letters started pouring out of the fireplace.

movie:603.text: I'm sick of the war and the gruel. I'd rather eat a juicy steak that isn't real, so I made a deal with the enemy.
I told him he wasn't the one he was hoping to be. Then I gave him a cookie and told him not to worry about the vase.
Humans are a virus, I told my prisoner. I wear a suit and sunglasses, and I can step into anyone.
An oracle told me I'd fall in love with someone special. I kissed him back to life.
I offered a hacker two pills: take the blue one and wake up in bed, or the red one and see how deep the rabbit hole goes.

movie:1726.text: We were prisoners in a cave. I kept his heart going with a magnet, and we built something very different from the missile they wanted.
I came to grill a billionaire about selling weapons. I woke up in his bed, and his assistant showed me out.
I ran the company with his father. I sold weapons to both sides, and I paid terrorists to get rid of him.
I pick up his dry cleaning and see out his one-night stands. One night I had to reach into his chest to swap out a glowing part.
I was held captive in a cave and built a suit of armour to escape. At the press conference, I told everyone who was inside it.

movie:68718.text: We were marching a chain of men through the woods at night when a dentist in a wagon offered to buy one.
I've run my master's house for decades. I'm the one who worked out the visitors weren't really there to buy fighters.
I love skull science and fights to the death. Two visitors came to buy a fighter, but what they really wanted was a slave girl who spoke German.
I gave up dentistry to hunt wanted men. I bought a slave to help me find three brothers, and made him my partner.
I was freed in chains in the woods. All I wanted was my wife back, and I'd go through anyone in the way.

movie:475557.text: We were three office guys hassling a woman on a late train. A man in clown makeup started laughing at us.
We'd only talked once, in the elevator. He thought we were dating.
I played a clip of a failed comic on my show to laugh at him. Then I invited him on as a guest.
I keep writing letters to the rich man I used to work for, sure he'll help us. My son looks after me and gives me baths.
I have a condition that makes me laugh when I don't want to. I dreamed of being a comedian, and ended up in clown makeup on live TV.

tv:1399.text: I saw the dead walking beyond the wall and I ran. The lord of the north cut off my head for it.
I won my crown in a rebellion, and now I mostly drink and hunt. A boar got me in the end.
I drink and I know things. I'm the youngest son of the richest, most dangerous family in the land.
I walked into a funeral fire and came out with three baby dragons.
Winter is coming, my family says. I went south to serve my old friend the king, and found the capital full of lies.

movie:120.text: Four little travellers came into my inn, and one of them vanished into thin air in the middle of a song.
I let them look into my mirror and gave each one a gift. I was offered the thing they carried, and I said no.
I met four little travellers at an inn and led them through the wild. I'm heir to a throne I don't want.
I fell into shadow on a bridge, fighting a demon of fire. My last words to them were: fly, you fools.
I promised I'd never leave his side. We left the village carrying something everyone in the world wanted.

movie:597.text: I was up in the crow's nest on a freezing, moonless night. I spotted it and rang the bell, but it was already too late.
I built her. I had to tell the man in charge she'd sink within hours, and that there were only enough lifeboats for half the people aboard.
I gave my bride-to-be a priceless blue diamond. She left me for a penniless artist from the cheap decks.
I spent years and a fortune searching a wreck for a diamond. All I found in the safe was a drawing of a naked woman, and then she phoned me.
I won my ticket in a card game minutes before she sailed. I sketched a rich girl, taught her to spit like a man, and then we hit an iceberg.

movie:11324.text: I was assigned as his partner the day we arrived. A storm cut us off from the mainland.
I run a hospital for the criminally insane, out in the harbour. A patient vanished from a locked room, barefoot.
I drowned my three children. Then I disappeared from a locked cell, and a federal marshal came looking for me.
I keep coming back to my husband, soaked to the skin, telling him he has to get away from this place.
I came to an island hospital to find a missing patient. I had my own reasons for being there.

movie:16869.text: A German colonel came to my farm, drank a glass of my milk and asked about Jewish families. They were hiding under my floor.
I'm a German film star secretly working for the British. I lost a shoe in a shootout in a basement tavern.
I run a cinema in Paris. A young war hero has a crush on me, and now the Nazis want to hold their premiere at my theatre.
They call me the Jew Hunter, and I'm proud of it. I speak four languages and I always know who's hiding.
My men and I want one thing from every Nazi we meet: their scalps.

movie:76341.text: I ride at the front of the war convoy, strapped to a truck full of drums, playing a guitar that shoots fire.
I wanted to die a glorious death in battle and be carried to the halls of the dead. Instead I fell for a red-haired runaway.
There were five of us, kept as a warlord's brides. We escaped in a war rig and left him a message: we are not things.
I control the water in my desert citadel. My best driver stole my wives.
I was captured and used as a living blood bag. Then I helped a one-armed driver escape across the desert.

movie:807.text: I was paid to bring a box out to two detectives in an empty field in the middle of nowhere.
I told my husband's older partner I was pregnant before I'd even told my husband.
I gave the city a sermon in seven parts, one for each of the deadly sins.
I moved to the city with my wife to make a name for myself. A killer made sure I'd never forget the last day of the case.
Seven days from retirement, I got a case that started with a dead man face down in a plate of spaghetti.

movie:672.text: I haunt the girls' bathroom. I died there, and I'm still crying about it.
I've written bestsellers about my adventures. I lost my memory to a broken wand.
I'm a house-elf. I stopped a boy from getting to his train, for his own good.
I'm an old diary. When you write in me, I write back.
In my second year, students were found petrified in the corridors, and I was the only one who heard a voice in the walls.

movie:284054.text: I was shot protecting a king, and woke up in his sister's lab.
I stole a rare metal from a hidden African nation, and now I wear it on my arm as a cannon.
I design the gadgets for my brother, the king. His new shoes soak up sound.
I grew up in Oakland. I came home and challenged my cousin for the throne at the waterfall.
After my father died, I went home to take the throne of my hidden, high-tech nation.

movie:150540.text: I'm part cotton candy, part elephant, and I cry candy.
I keep her safe. I made a list of everything that could go wrong on her first day.
I touched her happy memories and turned them sad. I didn't mean to.
We moved from Minnesota to San Francisco, and the pizza here has broccoli on it.
I live in a girl's head, and I want every one of her memories to be golden.

movie:238.text: I was sent to a bar to pretend I wanted to switch sides. They pinned my hand to the counter with a knife.
I went to him on his daughter's wedding day to ask for justice for mine. He gave it, but made sure I knew that one day I'd owe him a favour.
I married a decent man who promised his family's business would never be his. The last thing I saw was a door closing in my face.
I refused to give a singer a part in my movie. The next morning I woke up with my prize horse's head in my bed.
I came home from the war wanting nothing to do with my father's business. Then someone shot him in the street.

movie:70160.text: I designed her a dress that burst into flames. The crowd fell in love with her.
I drew the names at the ceremony in my best wig. A girl volunteered before I'd even finished reading.
I won the contest years ago and I've been drunk ever since. This year I finally had players worth sending gifts to.
I once threw a starving girl a loaf of bread. Years later I told the whole country on live TV that I loved her.
My name was drawn out of thousands. My big sister took my place.

movie:673.text: I'm a shrunken head hanging in a purple bus for stranded wizards. Take it easy, Ern!
I insulted my nephew's parents at dinner, then blew up like a balloon and floated away.
I'm the new teacher for defence against the dark arts. Once a month I get very unwell.
I broke out of a jail everyone said was impossible to escape. They say I'm coming for the boy.
In my third year, a dangerous convict on the run came looking for me, and the guards who suck out your soul were posted around my school.

movie:11.text: I bought two droids from traders for the farm, and told my nephew he could leave for the academy next year.
I blew up a peaceful planet to make a princess talk.
I gave a farm boy his father's weapon and told him about a mystical energy that binds everything together.
I fly the fastest ship in the galaxy. An old man paid me to carry him, a boy and two droids to a planet that turned out to be gone.
I hid secret plans in a little droid with a message: help me, you're my only hope.

movie:22.text: I'm the drunk blacksmith who takes the credit. My apprentice does all the work.
You are without doubt the worst pirate I have ever heard of, I told him.
My crew and I can't feel, can't eat, and in the moonlight we're skeletons.
I took a gold medallion from a boy we pulled out of the sea, and kept it for years.
My crew mutinied and left me on a desert island. Now I want my ship back.

movie:284053.text: I'm made of rocks. I tried to start a revolution, but I only printed enough pamphlets for my mum and her boyfriend.
I run a planet of trash and gladiator fights. My champion is a big green fellow.
I used to ride with an elite band of warrior women. Now I drink and sell fighters to a mad ruler on a garbage planet.
I was locked away for centuries. When our father died, I came back to claim the throne.
I lost my hammer and my hair, and was forced to fight an old friend in a gladiator arena.

movie:105.text: We gave a scientist our plutonium so he could build us a bomb. He gave us a bomb casing full of old pinball machine parts.
I told that boy he was a slacker, just like his father was when he went to my school.
I pushed the same nerd around for years. One night at a dance he finally fought back, and somehow I ended up waxing his car for a living.
A strange boy got hit by my father's car, and I nursed him in my bedroom. I fell for him completely, but he kept pushing me toward his shy friend.
My machine finally works. All it needs is 1.21 gigawatts, and the only way to get that is a bolt of lightning hitting the clock tower.

movie:14160.text: We wanted to buy an old man's little house for our building site. He hit one of my workers with his cane.
I lead a pack of dogs in the jungle. My talking collar broke, and now I sound like a cartoon chipmunk.
I was the greatest explorer of my day, until they called my giant bird a fake. I've been hunting one in the jungle ever since.
I needed one last badge, for helping the elderly. I was standing on his porch when his house took off.
I promised my wife we'd move our house to a waterfall in South America, so I tied thousands of balloons to it.

tv:66732.text: A student called me at home to ask how you'd travel to another dimension. I explained it with an acrobat and a flea.
I'm a small-town police chief who drinks too much. A boy went missing, and his mother started talking to Christmas lights.
My son vanished. I hung Christmas lights all over the house and painted the alphabet on the wall so he could talk to me.
I escaped from a lab with a shaved head and a number tattooed on my arm. I love waffles.
We ride our bikes everywhere and play Dungeons & Dragons. When our friend went missing, we found a strange girl in the woods.

movie:286217.text: I spotted things moving in satellite photos of a site the crew had already left behind.
I worked out a slingshot route around Earth that would send the ship back for him, and I had to sneak it past my bosses.
I left a crewman behind in a storm, sure he was dead. The only music he had left was my disco collection.
One of our astronauts turned out to be alive, alone on another planet, and I had to decide whether to tell his crew.
Left behind on Mars, presumed dead, I grew potatoes in my own, er, fertiliser.

movie:354912.text: I'm very old and I forget almost everything. Then my great-grandson sang me my father's song, and I remembered.
I was the most loved singer in my country, and a boy dreamed of being just like me. I was crushed by a falling church bell.
In our family, music is forbidden. We make shoes, and I wave my slipper at anyone who forgets.
I'm about to be forgotten in the land of the dead. A living boy promised to put my photo on his family's altar.
My family bans music, but I play guitar in secret. On the Day of the Dead, I ended up in the land of the dead.

movie:98.text: I wanted my general, not my son, to rule after me and give power back to the people. My son embraced me and smothered me.
I buy slaves and turn them into fighters. I was a fighter once myself, freed by an emperor.
My brother is emperor, and the man I once loved is fighting in his arena.
I murdered my father for the throne. A masked slave became the crowd's favourite, so I fought him myself.
They killed my wife and son and sold me as a slave. I fought my way to the arena in Rome to get my revenge.

movie:245891.text: A rich kid brought me a stolen car. When I saw whose car it was, I punched him.
At my hotel there are rules: no business on the premises, and we only take gold coins.
My son stole a car and killed a dog. I told him the man he'd robbed once killed three men in a bar with a pencil.
Before I died, I arranged for a puppy to be delivered to my husband, so he'd have something to love.
I left the business for my wife. After she died, some punks stole my car and killed the puppy she left me.

movie:496243.text: I kept a rich family's house for years, until someone convinced them I had tuberculosis using a little peach fuzz.
Our tutor recommended an art therapist for my son. She recommended a driver, and he recommended a housekeeper.
My new driver is good, but there's a smell about him I can't stand.
A friend gave me a scholar's rock and a job tutoring a rich girl. I forged my university papers.
My whole family was out of work, folding pizza boxes in our half-basement flat. One by one, we all got jobs in the same rich house.

movie:557.text: I promised a skinny kid three thousand dollars if he lasted three minutes in the ring. I paid him a hundred.
I want pictures of that wall-crawling menace on my desk by morning. The kid with the camera works cheap.
I tested an experimental formula on myself, and a voice in the mirror started talking back.
With great power comes great responsibility, I told my nephew in the car.
I hung upside down in the rain and kissed the masked hero who'd saved me.

movie:12.text: My uncle got me the best present ever: a fish in a bag! I always give my fish a little shake to say hello.
I hang around a dentist's window to gossip. One day I flew a frantic father and his friend straight into the office.
Our group has one rule: we're friends, not food. Then one of our guests got a nosebleed.
Totally rode the big current with a stressed-out dad and his forgetful friend. Righteous.
I'm helping a worried dad search the ocean for his son. I forget almost everything, but I can read, and I remember one address: 42 Wallaby Way, Sydney.

movie:37165.text: I've been his best friend since we were kids. I bring the beer, and I say exactly what I'm told to say.
I always hold the products up to the camera. This cocoa is made from real mountain-grown beans.
I drowned in a storm when he was a boy. Twenty years later I came back, out of nowhere.
I built him a whole world under a giant dome and filmed every second of it. I control the weather.
Good morning, and in case I don't see you: good afternoon, good evening and good night.

movie:10681.text: I'm the robot's only friend on the empty planet. He keeps squashing me by accident. I'm fine.
I'd never seen my home planet. A computer taught me about dancing, farming and pizza, and then I stood up on my own two feet.
My orders are clear: the ship must never go back. One little plant is not going to change that.
I was sent to find a plant. A rusty little robot fell for me and gave me one.
I've spent centuries compacting trash alone on Earth, watching the same old musical on tape.

movie:210577.text: I defend husbands accused of killing their wives. I coached this one for a TV interview by throwing jelly beans at him.
I run a bar with my brother. On his anniversary his wife disappeared, and he ended up sleeping on my couch.
In the missing woman's house I found a trail of clues set up like a treasure hunt.
We turned our daughter into the heroine of a hit children's book series. When she vanished, the whole country was watching.
On our fifth anniversary my wife vanished, and soon the whole country thought I'd killed her.

movie:346364.text: I carved my name into a new kid's stomach. Then a voice from the sewers told me to kill my own father.
I spend my summer in the library reading the town's history. Children go missing here every twenty-seven years.
Blood burst out of my bathroom sink and my dad couldn't see it. My friends helped me clean it up.
I chased my paper boat into a storm drain. A clown down there offered to give it back.
My little brother vanished in a storm last year. My friends and I went down into the sewers to find him.

movie:862.text: I like to blow up my toys and swap their heads around. Then they came alive in my backyard.
We live in a claw machine at a pizza place. The claw is our master, and it chose a spaceman.
I'm a piggy bank with a sharp tongue. When the new guy went missing, I helped the others blame the cowboy.
I thought I was a real space ranger, until I saw a TV ad for myself.
I was the boy's favourite toy, until a spaceman showed up on his birthday.

movie:8587.text: We're three hyenas living in the elephant graveyard. We helped a usurper take a kingdom and got nothing but scraps.
I'm the king's adviser, a bird who reports the morning news. The new king locked me in a cage and made me sing.
We found a cub collapsed in the desert and taught him our motto: no worries.
My brother was king. I arranged a stampede, then told his son it was all his fault.
I ran away believing I'd killed my father. Years later, I came home to take back the throne.

movie:585.text: My one-eyed boyfriend took me out for sushi on my birthday, and a child ran into the restaurant.
I'm always watching. Always. And your paperwork is due.
I can turn invisible. I built a machine to suck the screams straight out of children.
I followed a big blue monster back through a closet door, and I called him Kitty.
I'm the top scarer at the factory. Then a little girl got into our world, and I found out kids aren't toxic after all.

tv:71446.text: I'm the British ambassador's daughter. I was taken hostage on a school trip to the mint.
I lead the police negotiations. I met a charming man in a café, with no idea who he really was.
I'm the robber in charge inside the building, and I'm dying. My code name is a city.
I'm the narrator, a woman on the run. Every robber on the team is named after a city.
I spent years planning the robbery of the Royal Mint of Spain. I wear glasses and a cheap suit.

movie:497.text: I lived on death row. One of the inmates taught me to fetch a spool, and a gentle giant brought me back to life.
I'm well connected, so nobody can touch me. I made sure one execution went horribly wrong.
I was dying of a brain tumour. A huge man from the prison breathed it out of me.
I'm tired of people being ugly to each other. They say I killed two little girls.
I ran a block of death row cells. One prisoner cured my bladder infection with his hands.

movie:24.text: I swore I'd never make another sword. For her I broke my oath, because the man she's hunting was once my student.
I'm a teenager in a school uniform who guards a crime boss, swinging a spiked ball on a chain.
I traded killing for a quiet life with my daughter. One afternoon an old colleague came to my door, and my little girl got home from school in the middle of it.
I run the Tokyo underworld. When a boss mocked my background at the table, I cut off his head.
Shot at my own wedding rehearsal and left in a coma for four years, I woke up with a list of names.

movie:694.text: I looked after this hotel before him. I corrected my wife and daughters, too.
The bar was closed for the winter, but I poured him a drink anyway. His money was no good here.
I can talk to the boy without speaking. I told him to stay out of Room 237.
I finally read what my husband had been writing all winter: the same sentence, over and over.
I ride my trike through the halls of an empty hotel. My invisible friend lives in my mouth.

movie:9806.text: I'm his boss at the insurance company. I told him to stop helping customers, and he threw me through several walls.
I make suits for heroes, darling. No capes! A cape once got caught in a jet engine.
My wife won't tell me where my super suit is, and the whole city is in danger.
I was his biggest fan as a kid. He told me to go home, so I built my own gadgets and became his enemy.
I gave up being a hero for an insurance job. Then a secret mission lured me back into my old suit.

movie:419430.text: I work airport security, and I told my friend not to go to his girlfriend's parents' house. I was right.
I sprint across the lawn at full speed in the middle of the night. Nothing strange about that.
I'm a hypnotherapist. I stir my tea with a silver spoon, and you sink through the floor.
I told my daughter's new boyfriend I'd have voted for Obama a third time if I could.
I went with my girlfriend to meet her parents for the weekend. The staff were acting very strange.

movie:808.text: Not my gumdrop buttons! A tiny ruler tortured me by dunking me in milk.
I showed a very short ruler three princesses to choose from, like a dating show.
I guarded a princess in a castle surrounded by lava. Then I fell for a donkey.
I was waiting in a tower for true love's kiss. Every night after sunset, I kept a secret.
I would not stop talking, so a grumpy ogre finally let me tag along on his quest.

tv:1396.text: I'm a drug enforcement agent hunting a cook who goes by a fake name. I also collect minerals.
My clients are criminals, my ads are on bus benches, and I know a guy who knows a guy.
I run a chain of fried chicken restaurants, and a drug empire behind them.
I was his worst chemistry student. Now we cook together in a camper van in the desert.
I'm a chemistry teacher with terminal cancer. I started cooking drugs to provide for my family.

movie:2062.text: My review cost that restaurant a star. Then a plate of a humble peasant dish took me right back to my childhood.
Anyone can cook, I wrote in my book. I died after a bad review, and now I appear to a small cook in his imagination.
I run a famous Paris kitchen now the founder is gone, and I put his face on frozen burritos.
I can't cook at all, but something under my hat pulls my hair and steers my hands.
I have a nose for flavour and I dream of cooking in Paris. The trouble is, I'm a rat.

movie:1891.text: I brought the fleet out of hyperspace too close to the rebel base. My lord was not pleased.
I run a mining colony in the clouds. I made a deal with the enemy and handed over my old friend.
I live in a swamp. Size matters not, I told the young pilot who crashed his ship in my bog.
I was frozen in a block of carbonite. Her final words to me were I love you, and I said I know.
I lead the enemy fleet from behind a black mask, and I choke officers who fail me.

movie:129.text: I have six arms and run the boiler room of a bathhouse for spirits. Little soot balls carry the coal.
I can't speak. I offered gold to everyone in the bathhouse, and swallowed a few of them.
I run the bathhouse, and I take my workers' names so they forget who they are.
I'm a boy who can turn into a dragon, and I've forgotten my real name.
My parents ate food they found at an abandoned theme park and turned into pigs. I had to work in a bathhouse for spirits to save them.

movie:274.text: I keep the most dangerous man in the country in my hospital basement, and I never miss a chance to take the credit.
I was kidnapped and thrown into a pit in someone's basement. He lowers lotion down to me in a basket.
I'm sewing myself a suit, and I keep moths in my house.
I sent my best trainee to interview an imprisoned psychiatrist, hoping he'd help us catch a killer.
A brilliant imprisoned doctor asked me about my childhood, and the animals I heard screaming on my uncle's farm.

movie:269149.text: I work at the licence office. I am very... very... thorough.
I'm the most feared crime boss in the city. I'm also about the size of a mouse.
I'm the mayor's overworked assistant, a sheep, and he treats me like dirt.
I sell melted ice pops to lemmings for a living. A rabbit cop blackmailed me into helping her.
I'm the first rabbit on the city's police force, and they put me on parking duty.

movie:18785.text: Three idiots in Vegas took something of mine. I jumped out of the trunk of their car, naked.
Someone stole my tiger. I knocked one of them out cold in my own living room.
I woke up missing a tooth, married to a woman I'd met that night.
I put something in our drinks at the start of the night, thinking it would loosen us up.
My friends threw me a bachelor party in Vegas. I spent it stuck on a hotel roof while they searched the city for me.

movie:313369.text: I offered an old friend a steady gig playing keyboards in my pop band. Jazz purists hated it.
I told my pianist to play the Christmas list only. He played his own music, so I fired him.
We dragged our roommate to a Hollywood party in matching coloured dresses.
I dream of opening my own jazz club, and I keep getting fired for playing what I want.
I serve coffee on a studio lot between auditions. A rude pianist and I keep running into each other.

movie:329.text: Underpaid and overworked, so I took a side deal: steal a few samples and switch off security for a few minutes. Then the storm came in.
I was sent to tell the investors whether the place was safe. I spent the most important moment of my career in a bathroom.
I told them the clever ones should all be destroyed. One of them proved me right.
Grandpa invited us to see his new attraction. I know computers, and I got the doors locked just in time.
I dig up old bones and I can't stand kids. A rich man flew me to his island to approve his new attraction, and I ended up babysitting his grandkids while the exhibits hunted us.

tv:1402.text: I found a man in a hospital gown wandering my street and took him in. My dead wife still walks outside.
I thought my best friend died in the hospital, so I looked after his wife and son.
I was sure my husband was dead. Then he walked into our camp.
My dad wears a sheriff's hat. I learned to shoot before I was a teenager.
I woke up from a coma, and the world had been overrun by the dead.

movie:424.text: I'm the commandant's maid. He beats me, and tells me he can't help how he feels about me.
I kept the factory's books, and at the end I typed the names that would be saved, page after page.
I shoot prisoners from my balcony before breakfast.
In a black-and-white world, I was the only one in colour.
I came to make money from cheap labour in my factory. I ended up spending everything I had to save the people working there.

movie:1124.text: A magician came to my lab in Colorado asking for a machine. What I built him was far more than a trick.
I design the illusions for the stage. I warned my magician that his obsession would ruin him.
I worked on stage for one magician, then spied on him for his rival.
My wife drowned in a water tank during a trick. I blame my rival, and I'll do anything to beat his greatest illusion.
I perform a trick no one can work out, and I keep the secret even from the people I love.

movie:109445.text: We're rock trolls. When a little princess was struck with ice, we took away her memories of her sister's magic.
Big summer blowout! I sold a mountain man carrots and rope in the middle of a blizzard.
I sell ice for a living, and my best friend is a reindeer. A princess paid me to take her up the mountain.
I've never seen summer, but I can't wait. I like warm hugs.
I have powers I can't control. At my coronation I accidentally plunged the kingdom into an endless winter.

movie:857.text: I'd never fired a gun in combat. I froze on the stairs while my friend was killed.
When I learned three brothers had been killed, I read an old letter from Lincoln aloud and ordered the fourth one brought home.
I say a prayer from the Bible before I pull the trigger.
A squad came all this way to send me home. I wouldn't leave my post at the bridge.
I'm a schoolteacher back home. After the beach landing, I was ordered to take my men behind enemy lines to find one soldier.

tv:93405.text: I challenge strangers at the subway station to slap paper tiles, then hand them a business card.
I'm the oldest player. We played marbles in an alley that looked just like my childhood.
I sneaked onto a mysterious island looking for my missing brother, disguised as one of the masked guards.
I'm a pickpocket from the North, and I need money to bring my family across the border.
I'm drowning in debt. I signed up to play children's games for a huge prize, and the losers were shot.

movie:640.text: I fell for a young doctor at my hospital, and my father got him a job in the district attorney's office.
I taught my son that a good suit and confidence open any door. Then my business collapsed and my wife left me.
We let a charming young pilot ride along on our flights for free. He'd never flown a plane in his life.
I chased a young con man around the world for years. Every Christmas Eve, he called me.
Before I turned nineteen, I'd passed myself off as a pilot, a doctor and a lawyer, and cashed millions in fake cheques.

movie:77.text: I rented him two rooms at once. He can't remember anyway, so why not?
I served him a beer I'd spat in. He wouldn't remember.

movie:77.who: The man from the insurance claim
movie:77.text: I couldn't make new memories, and an insurance investigator decided I was faking.
I've been helping him find the man who killed his wife. He keeps my photo with a note telling him not to trust me.
I can't make new memories, so I tattoo the clues to my wife's murder on my body.

movie:244786.text: I'm a writer who ended up teaching high school. I take my son to the movies, and I worry about him.
I worked at the cinema. He broke up with me because he said I'd get in the way of his drumming.
I was the core drummer until a new kid showed up, and then the conductor kept swapping us.
Not quite my tempo. I throw chairs at students to make them great.
I practised until my hands bled, and crawled out of a car crash to make it to a concert.

movie:348.text: I'm the ship's cat. I came through it when most of the crew didn't.
I opened the airlock for a crewmate with something on his face, against every quarantine rule.
I looked into a strange egg on a dead planet, and something jumped onto my face.
All we wanted was our fair share of the bonus. Then one of us went looking for the cat.
I was the only one who wanted to keep the quarantine. In the end it was just me and the cat.

movie:38.text: I work at a clinic that erases memories, and I have a crush on my boss.
I erased a woman's memories of her boyfriend, then used his love letters to win her for myself.
I run a clinic that deletes painful memories. My team does it overnight, while you sleep.
I dye my hair a new colour every few weeks. After we broke up, I had him erased from my memory.
I found out my ex had me erased from her memory, so I did the same, and regretted it halfway through.

movie:101.text: I hid drugs for some crooked cops and helped myself to a little. They came back to my apartment.
I hand out the jobs to my best hit man and keep his money safe for him.
I pop my pills, listen to Beethoven, and wipe out whole families who cheat me.
When my family was killed, I knocked on the neighbour's door. Now I want him to teach me his job.
I drink milk and carry a houseplant everywhere. A twelve-year-old girl has moved in with me.

movie:1422.text: I work for the police department. I fell for one officer, and found myself treating another.
I'm one of only two people who know about our man on the inside, and I'm not nice about it.
I sent a young cop straight out of the academy undercover into the mob.
I raised a kid from the neighbourhood and got him into the police. Now I think there's a rat in my own crew.
I went undercover inside the Irish mob in Boston, while the mob had its own man inside the police.

movie:120467.text: I stayed at a faded old resort in the mountains and met its owner, who told me over dinner how he came to own it.
I planned the jailbreak. We smuggled in the tools hidden inside pastries.
My mother left a priceless painting to the concierge, so I sent my thug to hunt him down.
I was a young refugee working as a lobby boy at a famous mountain resort, and my mentor taught me everything.
I'm the concierge of a famous hotel in the mountains, and the elderly ladies adore me. One of them died and left me a painting.

movie:118.text: I'm obsessed with TV and video games. I got shrunk and beamed into a television.
I chewed a gum that tastes like a three-course dinner and turned into a giant blueberry.
I fell into a river of melted sweets and got sucked up a pipe.
I hadn't left my bed in years. When my grandson found a golden ticket, I got up and danced.
I found the last golden ticket and won a tour of the most magical sweet works in the world.

movie:20352.text: I run a bank for villains. I told one of my customers to come back with a real plan, like his young rival.
I wear an orange tracksuit, live in a fortress, and I stole a famous pyramid.
I run a home for girls, and I lock them in a box of shame.
It's so fluffy I'm gonna die! A supervillain adopted me and my sisters.
I adopted three orphan girls to help me get a shrink ray, all part of my plan to steal the moon.

movie:607.text: Something crashed on our farm. My husband went out to look, and came back with his skin hanging a little loose.
I sell illegal gadgets from other planets. They keep blowing my head off, and it keeps growing back.
A body on my table had a tiny alien living in its head. The agents keep wiping my memory.
I've policed aliens on Earth for decades. I recruited a street cop who chased one up the side of a museum.
I was a New York cop until I chased a suspect who wasn't human. Now I wear a dark suit and erase people's memories.

movie:218.text: I interviewed a man who said he came from the future, and told the detectives he was crazy.
I share an apartment with a waitress. I had my headphones on when someone broke in.
A huge man walked into my station, looked at the desk sergeant, and said: I'll be back.
I came back from the future to protect a woman. I fell in love with her from a photograph.
I'm a waitress in Los Angeles, and someone is killing every woman in the phone book with my name.

movie:769.text: My son brought his friends home in the middle of the night, and I made them dinner. They borrowed a big kitchen knife.
When my husband gave me a gun to hide, I found it turned me on.
Funny how? Funny like a clown? I amuse you?
I planned the big airport heist, and then everyone who knew about it started turning up dead.
As far back as I can remember, I always wanted to be a gangster. I ended up a nobody in witness protection.

movie:280.text: My patient keeps telling me about the end of the world. She broke out of my hospital with a paper clip.
My company is building a chip from the parts of a destroyed robot. I had no idea my work would end the world.
I can become anyone I touch. I'm here to kill a boy.
I've been locked in a hospital for warning everyone about a nuclear war. Nobody believes me.
I'm a ten-year-old in Los Angeles, and a huge cyborg came back in time to protect me.

movie:10191.text: I lost an arm and a leg to dragons, and now I run the forge. My apprentice is a scrawny kid.
I'm top of the class at fighting dragons. I followed him into the woods and found out his secret.
I'm the chief of a Viking village, and my son is nothing like me.
I'm the most feared of my kind. A boy shot me down, then built me a new tail fin.
I'm a Viking who can't bring myself to kill the beasts that raid our village, so I befriended one instead.

movie:8966.text: I'm the town's police chief. My daughter moved in with me, and she doesn't talk much.
I told her an old legend about the strange family across the line.
I hunt for sport. I caught a girl's scent at a baseball game in a thunderstorm.
I'm a doctor who has lived for centuries, and my family plays baseball in thunderstorms.
I moved to a rainy little town and fell for a pale classmate who sparkles in the sunlight.

movie:425.text: All I want is my acorn. I cracked a glacier trying to bury it.
We're the last of the dodos, stockpiling melons for the coming freeze. We lost all of them.
My pack sent me to bring back a human baby. I ended up protecting it.
My family left me behind during the migration, so I latched onto a grumpy mammoth.
I'm a grumpy mammoth walking the wrong way. A sloth and a tiger joined me to take a human baby home.

movie:546554.text: I'm the old lady who barely speaks. I saw someone climbing down the trellis that night.
I'm a lifestyle guru. My father-in-law paid my daughter's college fees, and I got paid them twice.
I'm the black sheep of the family, in a cable-knit sweater, and I told every one of them where to stick it.
I throw up whenever I lie. I was the last person to see the old writer alive.
A famous mystery writer died just after his eighty-fifth birthday, and someone anonymously hired me to look into it.

movie:489.text: He's the smartest guy I know. I told him I'd be insulted if he was still working construction with us in twenty years.
Someone solved the problem I'd left on the hallway blackboard. It was the janitor.
I met a guy in a bar who humiliated a pompous student over a history book, and then he asked for my number.
My wife died, and I keep telling this kid the same thing: it's not your fault.
I mop the floors at a famous university, and I solve the maths problems left on the blackboards.

movie:162.text: I offered him a chair in my salon. When he wouldn't fall for me, I told everyone he'd attacked me.
I built a young man in my castle on the hill. I died before I could give him hands.
My girlfriend's family took in a strange guy from the castle, and I used him to break into my dad's house.
I sell make-up door to door. I knocked at the castle on the hill and brought someone home with me.
I have blades where my hands should be. I cut hair, sculpt hedges, and make it snow.

movie:350.text: I'm on a diet. I don't eat anything, and when I feel like I'm about to faint, I eat a cube of cheese.
I told her to stop whining and see where she was working. Then I dressed her from the closet.
I'm a cook. My girlfriend started missing my birthday to run her boss's errands.
I wanted to be a journalist. Instead I fetch coffee and steaks, and once I had to find an unpublished book manuscript in an afternoon.
That's all. I run the most important fashion magazine in the world, and my assistants live in fear of me.

movie:277834.text: I'm the dumbest chicken on the island, and I stowed away on a canoe by accident.
I'm a treasure-mad crab in the realm of monsters, and I sang a whole song about being shiny.
I dance with the waves and tell stories no one believes. When I die, I'll come back as a manta ray.
I pulled up islands from the sea and stole the heart of a goddess. You're welcome.
The ocean chose me. I sailed beyond the reef to give back a stolen heart.

movie:85.text: I'm a monkey working for the bad guys in Cairo. I ate a poisoned date.
I'm a French treasure hunter. I took the golden idol from him in the jungle.
I run a bar in Nepal. My old flame came back for my father's medallion.
I helped him dig for a holy treasure in the Egyptian desert, while the Nazis dug in the wrong place.
I'm a professor with a whip and a hat. I hate snakes.

movie:111.text: My brother hated every man who looked at me. When I married his best friend, he shot him.
I took in a hungry Cuban refugee, and he took my business and my girl.
I married a drug lord and spent my days high and bored in a mansion.
We came over from Cuba on the same boat, and I married his sister.
I came to Miami with nothing and built an empire on cocaine. Say hello to my little friend.

movie:82690.text: I rule a racing game made of candy, and I keep one little racer off the track.
I'm a tough soldier from a shooting game, programmed with the most tragic backstory.
I'm a little glitch in a candy racing game, and I just want to race.
I have a magic hammer that fixes everything my game's villain breaks.
I've been the bad guy in my arcade game for thirty years. I left to win a medal and prove I can be good.

movie:745.text: I was his patient as a boy. Years later I broke into his house.
My son is scared all the time. In the car, he told me a message from my late mother that I'd never told anyone.
I was poisoned by my own mother. A boy brought a video to my father at my funeral.
After a former patient shot me, I took on a new case: a frightened little boy.

movie:9502.text: I run a noodle shop. My son dreams of martial arts, and I tell him the secret ingredient is nothing.
There are no accidents, I said, and pointed at the one nobody expected.
I broke out of a mountain prison to claim the scroll I was denied.
I'm a small, strict master who trained five great warriors. Now I have to train a hungry, clumsy giant.
I'm a clumsy, hungry kid from a noodle shop who fell out of the sky at a ceremony and was named the chosen warrior.

tv:1418.text: I'm a devout Texan mother. My genius son still needs me to sing him a song when he's sick.
I'm the only one in the group without a doctorate, and I've been to space.
I couldn't say a word to a woman unless I'd had a drink.
I'm a waitress and aspiring actress, and the guys across the hall are a pair of brilliant scientists.
That's my spot on the couch. Knock knock knock.

movie:11036.text: I didn't want my daughter with a boy from the lumber yard, so I hid all his letters.
I'm a wealthy soldier. She was engaged to me when she saw her old flame's picture in the paper.
I hung off a Ferris wheel until a girl agreed to go out with me.
One summer I fell for a local boy. Years later I came back to see the house he'd rebuilt, just as I'd wanted it.
Every day I read the same story to a woman in a nursing home, hoping she'll remember.

movie:194.text: I paint the same Renoir painting year after year, and I watch the girl across the street from my window.
I'm a cruel grocer. Someone keeps sneaking into my flat and swapping my slippers and my toothpaste.
My garden gnome keeps sending me photos of itself from around the world.
I collect torn photos thrown away at photo booths. A mysterious woman found my album.
I work in a café in Montmartre. I found a box of childhood treasures hidden in my flat and decided to secretly change people's lives.

movie:812.text: I'm a loud-mouthed parrot. I play the dumb bird for my master, the royal adviser.
I love my toys and my crackers. My daughter turns down every prince who comes to the palace.
I can't talk, but I'm great at charades, and I can fly.
I spent ten thousand years in a lamp. My new master is a street kid with three wishes.
I snuck out of the palace and met a street kid. Later a prince flew me around the world on a carpet.

movie:578.text: My boy was killed at the beach. I slapped the police chief for keeping it open.
It's the Fourth of July weekend, and the beaches stay open. The tourists bring the money.
I scraped my nails down a blackboard and offered to hunt the thing for ten thousand dollars.
I study the ocean. I cut open a fish on the dock to prove they'd caught the wrong one.
I'm afraid of the water, and something in it is eating my town's swimmers. We're going to need a bigger boat.

movie:197.text: I'm an Irishman who joined the Scots' rebellion. I'm a bit mad, and I talk to God.
I was sent to bargain with the rebel leader, and I fell in love with him.
I'm a Scottish noble who wants the crown. I betrayed him on the battlefield and regretted it.
I'm the cruel English king they call Longshanks, and I sent my soldiers north.
They killed my wife, so I painted my face blue and led the Scots to fight for their freedom.

tv:60574.text: I got a job singing in a Birmingham pub. I was really spying for a police inspector.
I was sent over from Belfast to clean up the city, starting with one gang.
I ran the family business while the boys were away at war.
I'm the oldest, but my younger brother gives the orders. I settle things with my fists.
I came home from the trenches and took over my family's gang. We sew razor blades into our caps.

tv:82856.text: I'm a bounty-hunting droid built to kill the target. Later I was reprogrammed to be a nurse.
I have spoken. I'm an old farmer who helped him rebuild his ship.
I paid a bounty hunter to bring me a fifty-year-old asset, alive.
I'm fifty years old, small and green, and I can lift things with my mind.
I never take off my helmet. I was sent to collect a bounty, and decided to protect it instead.

tv:60625.text: I turned myself into a pickle to get out of family therapy.
Press the button and one of us appears to do one task, and then we vanish. Existence is pain.
Nobody in this family respects me, least of all my wife's father.
My grandpa drags me across the universe. I just want to get through school.
I'm a drunk genius scientist with a portal gun.

tv:456.text: I run the local bar, and a boy keeps prank calling me.
Hi-diddly-ho, neighbourino! I'm the friendliest neighbour in town.
I own the nuclear plant. Excellent.
I play the saxophone, I'm a vegetarian, and I'm the smartest one in the family.
I work at the nuclear plant and I love doughnuts and beer. D'oh!

tv:119051.text: I'm a hand. I was sent to the school to keep an eye on a girl, and became her friend.
My roommate hates colour, and I'm all colour. I still can't change into a wolf.
I run a school for outcasts. I went to school here with the girl's mother.
I sent my daughter to the school where her father and I met.
I don't smile. I was expelled for putting piranhas in a swimming pool, and sent to a school for outcasts.

movie:747.text: I've had enough of the slob on our sofa. I got bitten by someone on my way home.
I tried to be a good stepdad, but he never liked me. Then I got bitten.
I dumped my boyfriend because all he ever wanted was to go to the pub. Then the dead started walking.
I play video games all day. When the dead came back, my mate and I holed up in our local pub.
I work in an electronics shop. It took me a while to notice the dead walking the streets of London.

tv:1668.text: I run the coffee shop. I've been in love with one of my regulars for years.
I left my husband for a woman, and then found out I was pregnant.
I play guitar at the coffee shop. My most famous song is about a smelly cat.
I ran out of my own wedding in my dress and found my old school friend in a coffee shop.
We were on a break! I've loved her since high school.

tv:87108.text: My husband was called to a fire at the plant. I stayed with him in the hospital, even when they told me not to touch him.
We dug a tunnel under the plant in the heat, and we worked naked.
I ran the test that night. I said it couldn't explode.
I was sent to the disaster with a scientist. At first I didn't believe a word he said.
I was sent to the nuclear disaster to find out what really happened, and to tell the truth about it.

tv:1408.text: I'm his boss. I tell him to do his clinic hours, and he never does.
I'm a cancer doctor and his only friend. He steals my lunch.
We run the tests and break into patients' homes. He tells us everybody lies.
I'm on his team. He hired me partly because I'd once broken into a car.
I walk with a cane, I'm hooked on painkillers, and I solve medical mysteries while insulting everyone.

tv:100088.text: Two of us lived quietly in a fenced-off town, growing strawberries while the world ended.
I live in a town by a dam in Wyoming with my wife. My big brother turned up with a girl.
I lead the rebels in the quarantine zone. I asked a smuggler to take a girl out west.
I'm fourteen, I swear a lot, and I was bitten but never turned.
Twenty years after a fungus ended the world, I'm smuggling a girl across America.

tv:19885.text: I'm their landlady, not their housekeeper. They shoot holes in my walls.
I work in the hospital morgue and let him whip the corpses. I have a little crush on him.
I am the British government, more or less, and I keep an eye on my little brother.
I came back from Afghanistan with a limp and moved into a flat on Baker Street with a stranger.
I'm a high-functioning sociopath, and I solve crimes in modern-day London.

tv:2288.text: I run the infirmary. One inmate keeps coming in for insulin shots he doesn't need.
I'm a small-time robber who wants out to marry my girl. My new cellmate's tattoos are full of secrets.
I run things inside. A new inmate wants my help, and he knows I have friends on the outside.
I'm on death row for a murder I didn't commit. My little brother got himself locked up in here with me.
I had the building's blueprints tattooed all over my body, then robbed a bank to get myself locked up there.

tv:1100.text: We're sitting on the couch, and our dad has been telling us this story for years.
Suit up! I'm the legend of the group, and I have a playbook.
We're the steady couple of the group: a law student from Minnesota and a kindergarten teacher.
I'm a Canadian news reporter. On our first date he stole a blue French horn for me.
I'm telling my kids a very, very long story about how I found the woman of my life.

tv:1405.text: I'm a cop who swears a lot. My brother works in the lab and brings in doughnuts.
I was a cop. I taught my son a code: only kill the ones who deserve it.
I left frozen, bloodless bodies all over Miami, as a message to someone.
I've been through a lot. My boyfriend is gentle and patient, and he works with blood.
I analyse blood spatter for the Miami police. At night I'm a serial killer who only kills killers.

tv:87739.text: I taught a little girl to play chess in the orphanage basement.
I adopted a girl from an orphanage, and we travelled the world on her winnings, drinking all the way.
I'm the Soviet world champion. She lost to me in Paris after a night of drinking.
I was the Kentucky champion until she beat me. Later I moved in with her to help her train.
I grew up in an orphanage, saw chess pieces moving on the ceiling, and became a champion.

tv:2316.text: I spilled my famous chili all over the carpet at work.
I'm assistant to the regional manager, and I run a beet farm.
I'm the receptionist, engaged to a guy in the warehouse, and a salesman keeps making me laugh.
I put my coworker's stapler in jelly.
I'm the world's best boss. I have a mug that says so.

tv:4607.text: I was flying to Los Angeles to give my baby up for adoption. I never landed.
I won the lottery with a set of numbers, and they've brought me nothing but bad luck.
I couldn't walk before the crash. When I woke up on the beach, I could move my toes.
I read books on the beach and give everyone nicknames.
Our plane broke apart over an island, and I ended up leading the survivors.

tv:246.text: My cabbages! Every time those kids come through, my cart gets smashed.
I'm a retired general who loves tea, and I follow my banished nephew everywhere.
My father scarred my face and banished me until I capture him.
My brother and I found a boy frozen in an iceberg, with a giant flying bison.
I was frozen for a hundred years, and I'm the only one who can master all four elements.

tv:48891.text: I'm the precinct's civilian assistant. I don't care about anything, and I'm proud of it.
I'm huge, I lift weights, and I love yoghurt and my twin girls.
I'm an emotionless captain who loves his husband and his corgi.
I love binders, rules, and a goofy detective I used to find annoying.
I'm the goofiest detective in the precinct, and my new captain might be a robot.
